data.title: 新垣绫濑 · 厨房便当的温柔喂食试吃
data.description: 晨光穿透明亮的现代化厨房，系着碎花围裙的绫濑正精心准备双人便当。她用筷子夹起一块金黄厚蛋烧喂到你嘴边，微红着脸庞，眼神中写满了专属于心上人的极度温柔。
data.action: standing in clean modern kitchen with a floral apron, holding up a freshly rolled tamagoyaki on chopsticks to partner mouth, blushing with an expectant gentle smile
data.lighting: warm sunny morning light pouring through kitchen window
data.mood: devoted model girlfriend warmth, sweet domestic caring, heart-throbbing bride vibe
data.promptProse: Standing in a sunlit kitchen with an apron, Ayase Aragaki blushes with a tender loving smile, feeding partner a rolled egg on chopsticks.
data.animaCaption: Ayase Aragaki feeding partner rolled egg lovingly in sunny kitchen.
